key_features: YOUR BABY'S NURSERY STAYS COMPLETELY PRIVATE: The VM819 never connects to WiFi, the internet, or any cloud - it transmits exclusively via encrypted 2.4GHz FHSS technology directly between the camera and your parent unit, so only you can see and hear your baby

SEE EVERY DETAIL, DAY AND NIGHT, WITHOUT ENTERING THE ROOM: The 2.8-inch LCD delivers a real-time view with no streaming delay - infrared night vision activates automatically when the nursery gets dark, and 2x digital zoom lets you check on your newborn in close detail without disturbing them

WAKE UP ONLY WHEN YOUR BABY NEEDS YOU: Sound-Activated Screen Mode keeps the parent unit dark and quiet when the nursery is silent, then turns on automatically the moment your baby stirs - adjustable VOX sensitivity and a 3-level sound indicator help you set the right threshold for your baby's sleep patterns

MONITOR ALL NIGHT WITHOUT REACHING FOR A CHARGER: The 2,600mAh rechargeable battery delivers up to 19 hours of continuous video streaming - or up to 29 hours of audio-only monitoring - on a single charge, so one nightly charge covers overnight and into the next morning

SOOTHE YOUR BABY AND KNOW THEY'RE COMFORTABLE WITHOUT GOING IN: Two lullabies and two ambient sounds (white noise and trickling stream) play directly from the camera unit, 2-way talkback lets your baby hear your voice, and the nursery temperature sensor alerts the parent unit the moment the room needs adjusting
